_doc: Clan methods (proposals, unpriced). The Hỗ house has none. Builds name generated stand-ins because depth_check.py does not read people/*.techniques.json.

techniques.name: Locust Shade Breathing (Hòe Âm Tức Pháp)
techniques.concept: Sat at noon in the shade of a living locust. The leaves cool the air and the breath, and the root learns to draw Water qi down through Wood the way a tree draws water up. Slow and steady; it builds linh lực sustain and Wood regrowth, and it is useless while the holder burns: a Fire stack on her stops the regrowth until it clears.

arts.concept: A spray of yellow flower-darts that heal the caster a little for each that lands.
A cool ward that thickens while the caster stands still.

techniques.lore: Tiêu Chủng Hòe's, from the hunter's habit of resting under trees; written down in 700. The clan has never taught it outside the family.

techniques.name: Twin Span Pillar Method (Song Kiều Trụ Pháp)
techniques.concept: A mason's method: the cultivator stands waist-deep in moving water and sinks their qi into the riverbed like a pillar, so the current breaks around them. It trains health, block and the body's weight more than art power.

arts.new: Pillar in the Current (Trụ Lập Lưu)
arts.concept: A stance that turns the next three hits taken into blocks and pushes the attacker back.

techniques.lore: Ôn Giá Hồng's, from forty years of sinking pillars before the bridges of 900.

techniques.name: Returning Swallow Breath (Quy Yến Tức)
techniques.concept: The breath goes out and comes back as swallows leave and return: each cycle sends qi out to the limbs and draws it home with a little more. Its arts echo, striking once and again. The manual stops at the ninth layer, and the clan believes a second half stayed in the old hall.

arts.concept: A Wood dart that comes back to hit the same foe a second time at half power.

techniques.lore: The one method the Tạ carried out of their old hall in 470 (A193); its script is older than anything in Phong Lâm.

techniques.name: Seed Store Method (Tàng Chủng Pháp)
techniques.concept: Qi is put away like seed grain over winter: gathered in the autumn sittings, sealed, and drawn on only when needed. Slow to build, nothing wasted; it gives health and linh lực pools and a late surge.

arts.concept: Release the stored qi at once: a large heal and a short burst of art speed, once a fight.

techniques.lore: Lục Đa Cốc's farmer's method, after the harvest of 600. Every Lục child learns it before letters.

techniques.name: Reeling Thread Breath (Trừu Ti Tức)
techniques.concept: A breath drawn as fine and unbroken as a thread reeled from a cocoon in hot water: Fire heat, Earth patience. It builds long debuffs rather than hard hits. Sung, not read: the layers are verses of the Hỏa Ti reeling songs.

arts.concept: A Fire thread that binds a foe, lowering evade for as long as the caster keeps it drawn.

techniques.lore: Nhan Dư Ti's songs from Hỏa Ti (N-chuc_ha-01), written down by her grandson about 680.
